text:
tanya: weird one 0 mins of packet loss this morning and a low hum from the wall. turned out my downstairs neighbors e-scooter charger was plugged into the same circuit as my router. unplugged it and everything came back. pic: (image: scooter-charger-and-router.jpg)
ben: wait the charger actually radiates interference? wild. did you try moving the router to a different outlet?
tanya: yeah swapped to the outlet on the other wall and stable. i think the charger is noisy when its actively charging (big transformer hum).
omar: been there. chargers with SMPS can leak a surprising amount of noise on the mains. solved it with a cheap UPS between router and wall (filters hum + keeps power clean).
claire: note for the show-and-tell thread: "appliances that subvert my wifi" category. i'll bring my acoustic guitar that somehow turns into feedback during calls.
infra-bot: quick diagnostics triggered by tanya at 2160054330  pre-unplug: 1-min ping to staging avg=248ms, loss=9% ; post-unplug: avg=28ms, loss=0% . details sent to #eng-infra.
zach: popcorn emoji for the next WFH gallery. also pro tip: ferrite cores on power cables can help with EMI.
ben: ferrite cores, UPS, or a power strip with EMI/RFI filtering. cheap surge strips sometimes help but check the reviews.
tanya: thanks all. would people be into a "weird home interference" mini-guide? could be a one-pager with photos and quick fixes.
omar: yes please. i can write a short section on power-line vs radiated noise and non-invasive fixes.
claire: poll: show-and-tell tomorrow at 2pm or Thursday 6pm? react :one: for tomorrow 2pm, :two: for Thu 6pm.
ben: :one:
zach: :two:
omar: :two: (evening is easier)
tanya: :one: (tomorrow works cause i'll still be scooter-cleaning)
infra-bot: poll tally at 2160054355  :one: 2 votes, :two: 2 votes. tie persists.
claire: tie-breaker rule: whoever posts the most absurd culprit picks the time. anyone have a crazier story than an e-scooter charger?
ben: i once had a halogen lamp causing interference every time it warmed up.
zach: i had neighbor's old microwave that killed the 2.4GHz band when it leaked.
tanya: hmm maybe not that unique then  still up for making the guide. i'll post pics + steps later today.
claire: love it. last thing  who will actually clean their desk for show-and-tell? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
participants poll replies: tanya: maybe, ben: probably not, omar: nope, claire: yes, zach: maybe
